initial_state: new cash account; zero initial positions; no target until first in-window new-target event
scheduled_phase: full-history H20 from first finite source group; never restart in 2024
target_rule: equal weights on group[T]==1 AND liquid_prior[T+1]; no second shift
membership_rule: daily value membership[T] delivered at execution day T+1
pool_exit_rule: engine applies daily membership[T] to its new-account targets, actual holdings and pending directions; no imported source exit mask or source-state operation order
cdr_unit_rule: 689009.SH receipt and CNY/receipt; no automatic factor-of-ten conversion
